module: Vehicles loaned (loaners) by the career delivery organizations. It builds the offers displayed in the UI (formatLoanerOfferForUi), handles the selection then the spawning of loaned vehicles via a util_stepHandler sequence (fade, spawn, placement on a parking spot, adding to the inventory with owned = false, fade back in), returning the vehicles and a monitoring: a "work" vehicle left more than 100 m away for 300 s is returned automatically.
notes: Settings: walkAwayRadius 100 m, comeBackRadius 95 m, walkAwayTimeLimit 300 s, warning at 60 s remaining.
A loaner vehicle is added to the inventory with owningOrganization (facility.associatedOrganization) and loanType (offer.loanType, "work").
Returning a damaged work vehicle (inventoryVehNeedsRepair) costs the organization's returnLoanerDamaged reputation (-20) and shows a toast.

Offer unavailable if: no free slot, already a non-trailer loaner from this organization (limit 1, including those waiting to spawn), insufficient reputation, or insufficient delivery level (delivery branch). An offer already ticked stays enabled.
Proposed mileage: the offer's mileage according to the reputation level, plus about 5.8 * (1 ± 10%) per second elapsed since the save was created (i.e. 500 km per day according to the code comment).
Bug: M.spawnAndLoanVehicle = spawnAndLoanVehicle references an undefined variable: the field is nil.
spawnAllOffers: the last step only processes the first offer of markedForSpawningLoaners (next) to orient the camera, then empties the list.
onUpdate uses `break` after each action: only one vehicle is processed per frame.

spawnAndLoanVehicle.desc: Always nil: variable that does not exist in the file (bug).

markForSpawning.desc: Toggles the selection of an offer: adds it to the list of loaners to spawn, or removes it if it was already there.

offer.desc: Offer (id, model, config, sourceFacility, loanType, vehMileage).

unmarkAllForSpawning.desc: Empties the list of selected offers.

spawnAllOffers.desc: Spawns all the selected offers with a fade: spawn, initialization of the part conditions (mileage), placement on the best parking spot (trailers or not), adding to the inventory. Does nothing if nothing is selected.

returnVehicle.desc: Returns a loaned vehicle: updates the part conditions if it is present in the world, applies the reputation penalty if the work vehicle is damaged, then removes it from the inventory and calls callback.

callback.desc: Called once the vehicle is removed.

getLoanedVehiclesByOrg.desc: Lists (deep copies with thumbnail) the inventory vehicles loaned by the given organization.

getLoaningOrgsOfVehicle.desc: Returns the organizations that own the vehicle and, if it is coupled, the non-trailer towing vehicle.

formatSpawnedLoanersForUi.desc: Prepares for the UI the list of loaners already in the inventory: organization share (loanerCut), name, mileage, vehicle/trailer type, fluid capacity.

formatLoanerOfferForUi.desc: Prepares for the UI a facility's loan offers: availability (enabled), reason for unavailability, unlock info, mileage, capacity, thumbnail.

returns.desc: Offers, nil if the organization is unknown.

onVehicleAdded.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is added to the inventory: unblocks the waiting step of the spawn sequence.

onUpdate.desc: Frame hook: monitors work vehicles moving away (warning, then automatic return after the delay).
